integrity.finite_exhaustiveness: complete primes through the largest explicit witness 6165527, exact square-divisibility, independently checked prime witnesses

scientific_limitations: The assertion gives the least exceptional prime for each reduced residue modulo 36 and only for the four powers 1,2,4,8; it is not an infinitude or density theorem.
The r=7 numerical case may overlap with the motivating preprint computational tables; its primary full PDF was not accessible, although its public abstract was read.
Another unindexed table of first exceptional prime thresholds could duplicate part or all of the classification.
title: First four-shift squarefree failures in every prime residue class modulo \(36\)
